vocab.example: My role was to lead the front-end team and report to the project manager.
vocab.example_vi: Vai trò của tôi là dẫn dắt nhóm giao diện và báo cáo cho quản lý dự án.

vocab.example: I took ownership of the problem instead of waiting for my manager.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi đã chủ động nhận trách nhiệm xử lý vấn đề thay vì chờ quản lý.

vocab.example: Tell me about a time when you worked under strong deadline pressure.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy kể về một lần bạn làm việc dưới áp lực thời hạn rất lớn.

vocab.example: We had to narrow down the scope to three screens for the first release.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi phải thu hẹp phạm vi xuống ba màn hình cho bản phát hành đầu tiên.

vocab.example: As a result, we launched on time and the client renewed the contract.
vocab.example_vi: Kết quả là chúng tôi ra mắt đúng hạn và khách hàng đã gia hạn hợp đồng.

vocab.example: Interviewers prefer a real-life example to a general answer.

listening.title: Answering a behavioural question with the STAR structure

lines.speaker: Ms Mai (Interviewer)
lines.text: Hoang, could you tell me about a time when you worked under deadline pressure?

lines.speaker: Hoang (Candidate)
lines.text: Yes. Last year my team had to launch an online payment page in three weeks.

lines.speaker: Ms Mai (Interviewer)
lines.text: That sounds very tight. What was your role in that project?

lines.speaker: Hoang (Candidate)
lines.text: My role was to lead the front-end part and talk to the bank's technical team.

lines.speaker: Ms Mai (Interviewer)
lines.text: And how did you organise the work?

lines.speaker: Hoang (Candidate)
lines.text: I took ownership of the planning and narrowed down the scope to three must-have screens.

lines.speaker: Ms Mai (Interviewer)
lines.text: What happened to the other features?

lines.speaker: Hoang (Candidate)
lines.text: We moved them to phase two, and the client agreed after I explained the risk.

lines.speaker: Ms Mai (Interviewer)
lines.text: So what was the final outcome?

lines.speaker: Hoang (Candidate)
lines.text: As a result, we launched on time and the error rate stayed under one percent.

lines.speaker: Ms Mai (Interviewer)
lines.text: Nice. And what is your key takeaway from that project?

lines.speaker: Hoang (Candidate)
lines.text: In hindsight, I should have asked the QA team for help one week earlier.

shadowing: The situation was simple: our biggest client wanted a report every Monday.
My role was to collect the data and prepare the slides for my manager.
I took ownership of the problem and asked two teammates to help me.
As a result, we cut the reporting time from six hours to two.
In hindsight, my key takeaway was to ask for feedback much earlier.
